summary: Client-side pending item animation state request: one uint16 animation state (same kind of value as ecl::item::animation::RequestComponent.State, which SE already maps; default 4 like that one). Written by the per-frame update of ecl::item::animation::RequestsSystem. Never seen alive. Registry total 2 (client row). The savegame model game.item.animation.v0.PendingRequestComponent (size 8) belongs to esv::item::animation::PendingRequestComponent, not to this client type.

fields.name: State
fields.evidence: Creator bg3.exe+0x191B320 (AllocRaw 2) stores `*(undefined2*)p = 4`. bg3.exe+0x191A410 (called from the per-frame update of ecl::item::animation::RequestsSystem bg3.exe+0x1919320) takes a ushort state uVar3 from a per-item ushort array, skips states 1,2,3,5,7, and writes `*(ushort*)p = uVar3` into this component (getting it with FUN_14191b320 when absent); it later compares `*p != uVar3`. Same value domain as RequestComponent.State (eoc::item::animation::StateToString in SE's comment), whose default is also 4.
